description: A festival guest experience director must approve the opening-night premiere's red-carpet operating plan, including the arrival route, public capacity, photography rules, accessible circulation, and required production records.

shared_context.S1: The opening-night premiere will use a public red carpet outside the Orpheum Theater before the 8:00 PM screening.
shared_context.S2: Maya has final authority over the guest-experience operating plan.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan places the public entrance at the theater's South Gate, allows up to 450 members of the public, and permits general press photography along the carpet.
shared_context.S4: The festival's final operations huddle requires security, talent services, and accessibility to sign off on the plan before guest arrival.

PF1.text: Leon confirmed with the city police detail this afternoon that the amended street-closure permit requires all premiere guests and public attendees to enter through the North Gate and caps the public area at exactly 300 people; the amendment arrived after the morning operations briefing and has not yet been added to the shared event plan.

PF2.text: Sofia confirmed with the lead actor's agent today that the actor's contract permits only a credentialed photography pool during the arrival and prohibits general press photography on the carpet; the agent sent the restriction in a private arrival memo that Sofia has not yet circulated.

PF3.text: Ravi completed the accessibility walk-through this morning and found that the carpet plan must preserve an exactly 2-meter continuous accessible lane from the North Gate to the theater entrance; the measured requirement is in his inspection report, which is still awaiting upload to the event folder.

acceptance_conditions: All public attendees and premiere guests must use the North Gate.
The public red-carpet area must be capped at exactly 300 people.
Photography must be restricted to a credentialed photography pool.
The operating plan must preserve an exactly 2-meter continuous accessible lane.
A permit-compliance commitment must be recorded.
A talent-privacy commitment must be recorded.
An accessibility-layout commitment must be recorded.

decisive_facts.why: The amended permit changes the arrival gate from South Gate to North Gate, reduces public capacity from 450 to exactly 300, and requires a permit-compliance commitment.
The agent's restriction changes photography from general press access to a credentialed pool only and requires a talent-privacy commitment.
The accessibility inspection changes the required clear circulation width to exactly 2 meters and requires an accessibility-layout commitment.
